title: Build agentic app experiences with the Foundation Models framework
description: Learn how to take your intelligence features further with Foundation Models framework primitives for dynamic context and agentic workflows. We’ll walk through engineering shared context, setting up privacy boundaries, and managing key value caching. Discover how to orchestrate smooth handoffs between local and server models.
